question.prompt: Given a quadrilateral \(ABCD\) inscribed in a circle with side \(AB\) extended beyond \(B\) to point \(E,\) if \(\angle BAD=92^\circ\) and \(\angle ADC=68^\circ,\) find \(\angle EBC.\)

solutions.explanation:
The given angle at \(D\) is opposite the angle at \(B\). Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary, so
\[
\angle ABC=180^\circ-68^\circ=112^\circ.
\]
Since \(AB\) is extended beyond \(B\) to \(E\), rays \(BA\) and \(BE\) point in opposite directions. Hence \(\angle ABC\) and \(\angle EBC\) are also supplementary. Therefore
\[
\angle EBC=180^\circ-112^\circ=\boxed{68^\circ},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Use opposite angles
